text:
anika: Quick ping — PR #4723 is ready for review. Small change to KV prefetch timing + batching window; I saw a rare race on prewarm that can cause double-prefetching and bump memory briefly. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4723
sven: @anika can you paste the repro steps and any logs? I can try to reproduce locally on my 4-gpu node.
anika: repro: run load test with prewarm=on + batching window 50ms. Logs show `kv_fetch: started` twice for same key then OOM. snippet:
```
2026-03-10T14:01:23Z kv_fetch: started key=abc123
2026-03-10T14:01:23Z kv_fetch: started key=abc123
2026-03-10T14:01:23Z memory: usage 14.2GB -> OOM
```
liam: I'll take a quick look — focusing on the prefetch gate and the atomic flags. If it's small I'll ping back in ~30m. :eyes:
devon: prefer we don't merge to main until runtime-integration CI runs (longer tests) or we can canary on dedicated-qa. If it's safe, feature flag would be ideal.
anika: added `--kv-prefetch-lock` flag behind feature flag in PR, and added unit for concurrent prefetch. Also added a short e2e that reproduces double-start locally. PTAL.
sven: small suggestion: replace non-atomic `bool prefetch_started` with `std::atomic_flag` and use test-and-set semantics. Also guard the prewarm path with `if (!prefetch_started.test_and_set()) { ... }` — looks good otherwise.
liam: looked through the diff, agree with sven. left 2 tiny comments about logging and error path. otherwise LGTM. :+1:
devon: tagging @oncall-runtime to run a quick canary after merge? runtime-bot: @devon please confirm canary window
runtime-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-10T15:30:00Z on dedicated-qa. CI status: running.
liam: once CI passes I'm happy to approve and merge. will re-check the e2e results.
anika: thanks all — will wait for CI and then merge during the 15:30 canary window. I'll post back with results.
